data.turoyo: Mḥawaṭṭe u=maṭʕam, hani hbiṭi, maʕlalle iḏayye,
data.translation: Als sie das Speisehaus umstellten, wurden jene von Schrecken gepackt und hoben die Hände hoch.

rationale: Thin Preterit sense-1 cell; the complete consequence clause makes the encirclement and surrender understandable without surrounding narrative.

summary: All three occurrences illustrate II.1 umzingeln. Buildings and people can be encircled; this participant difference requires no new sense.

At 87/129 an overt l-marked pronominal agent precedes the encircled building. The next verse repeats the same encirclement event and supplies the other group’s fear and raised hands; it is a better context, not evidence for a second lexical use.
The unprefixed Infectum at 89/110 has a detective-group agent and a suffixed plural patient. The source writes mḥawtənne while the inherited quotation writes mḥawṭən-ne; keep this variation visible.
No supplied occurrence supports or challenges inherited sense 2, gern haben/gern kaufen wollen. Leave that existing sense and its example unchanged.
Check the source t versus inherited ṭ in 89/110 against the edition or recording before treating the spelling as dialectal de-emphasis or correcting the inherited text.
